% master.tex -- gauntlet-master root A: natbib author-year, refs.bib with a
% jobname master.bbl. Bracketed tags name inventory cases (coverage.md).
\RequirePackage{iftex}% [P4] \RequirePackage before \documentclass; [C3] \pdfoutput first
\documentclass[11pt]{gmvenue}% [C1] local class
\usepackage{gmstyle}% [N9] local package, which requires a second local package
\def\gmarxiv{}% [D4] flag by definedness, tested in body/paper.tex and sections/branches.tex
\makeatletter
% [N20] \input@path adds a search directory; figures.tex relies on it
\def\input@path{{./}{figures/}}
% [N1] wrapper main: neutralise the inner main's \documentclass ...
\renewcommand{\documentclass}[2][]{}
% [P11] ... and mark a package as loaded so it is never read
\expandafter\def\csname ver@gmfake.sty\endcsname{}
% [N4] save-and-wrap \bibliographystyle; the class flag picks the style
\let\gm@savedbst\bibliographystyle
\renewcommand{\bibliographystyle}[1]{\gm@savedbst{\gm@bst}}
\makeatother
% [N5] file hooks set up inside a macro
\newcommand{\gmfilehook}[1]{%
  \AddToHook{file/#1.tex/before}{\gmhooked{#1}}%
  \AddToHook{file/#1.tex/after}{\typeout{left #1}}}
\gmfilehook{sections/math}
\input{body/paper}
